# Go files that may hold Cyrillic string literals, one path per line with a
# reason after " — ". Everything else must keep its text in
# internal/i18n/locales/*.json and reach the user through Bot.loc/locData.
# tests/text_locales_test.go fails when a literal shows up outside this list.
internal/image/golden.go — sample timetable cells the golden renders are compared against
internal/parity/parity.go — suffixes the legacy texts carry, trimmed only for comparison
internal/parser/calls.go — bell-schedule page markup and labels the parser reads
internal/parser/group.go — group page markup, elective type and comment markers
internal/parser/table.go — weekday headings and cabinet prefixes of the site
internal/parser/teacher.go — teacher page markup
internal/rooms/rooms.go — cabinet prefix used to clean the site rooms
internal/search/normalize.go — ё/е fold shared by every search
internal/search/translit.go — Cyrillic keyboard layout and transliteration tables
internal/telegram/archive.go — the /archive week matcher accepts the Russian word
internal/telegram/commands.go — the calculator alphabet includes Cyrillic к as "000"
internal/telegram/inputcmds.go — matchers for the localized reply-keyboard buttons
internal/telegram/surface.go — sample chats the parity surface walks
internal/testgolden/golden.go — regexes that normalize Russian message goldens
